title: Sazmining Now Sells Jack Dorsey’s Proto Immersion Hashboards
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Sazmining Now Sells Jack Dorsey’s Proto Immersion Hashboards Block’s Proto mining hashboards are now available on Sazmining’s mining-as-a-service platform. This post Sazmining Now Sells Jack Dorsey’s Proto Immersion Hashboards first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
